title: ReverseDock
description: Traffic, latency, backends, certificates, reloads and alerts of ReverseDock (rdock). Every query uses metrics rdock exports at /metrics.

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: All requests on the selected listeners and routes.

panels.title: 5xx share
panels.description: Share of answers with a 5xx status, including requests whose client went away.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile from request headers to the end of the response.

panels.title: Open connections
panels.description: Client connections open now.

panels.title: Backends down
panels.description: Backends that take no traffic: failed health checks, ejected or drained.

panels.title: First certificate expiry
panels.description: Days until the certificate that expires first. Empty when rdock has no certificates.

panels.title: Configuration generation
panels.description: Generation of the configuration in use; it grows with every applied change.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Version of the running binary.

panels.title: Failed reloads (1h)
panels.description: Configurations rejected in the last hour; the previous one stays in use.

panels.title: Alert delivery failures (1h)
panels.description: Alerts that could not be delivered in the last hour.

panels.title: Requests by route
panels.description: Requests per second.

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Requests per second.

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: From request headers to the end of the response.

panels.title: p95 latency by route
panels.description: From request headers to the end of the response.

panels.title: 5xx share by service
panels.description: Share of each service's answers with a 5xx status.

targets.expr: (sum by (service) (rate(rdock_http_requests_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",listener=~"$listener",route=~"$route",status_class="5xx"}[$__rate_interval])) or (0 * sum by (service) (rate(rdock_http_requests_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",listener=~"$listener",route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))) / sum by (service) (rate(rdock_http_requests_total{job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance",listener=~"$listener",route=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests by method
panels.description: Requests per second.

panels.title: Open connections
panels.description: Client connections open now, by listener.

panels.title: New connections
panels.description: Connections accepted per second, by listener.

panels.title: TLS handshake errors
panels.description: Handshakes that failed or did not finish in time, per second.

panels.title: Backend state
panels.description: 1 takes traffic, 0 does not (failed health checks, ejected or drained).

panels.title: Answers by backend
panels.description: Answers per second from each backend, by status class.

panels.title: Backend p95 latency
panels.description: From sending the request to a backend to its response headers.

panels.title: Connection errors
panels.description: Failed attempts to connect to a backend, per second.

panels.title: Retries
panels.description: Requests sent again after a failure, and retries refused by the retry budget, per second.

panels.title: Ejections
panels.description: Backends ejected after repeated failures, in each interval.

panels.title: Mirrored requests
panels.description: Copies sent to mirror services, by outcome, per second.

panels.title: Certificate expiry
panels.description: Days until each certificate expires.

panels.title: ACME orders
panels.description: Certificate orders by CA and result, in each interval.

panels.title: Renewal failures
panels.description: Failed attempts to issue or renew a certificate, in each interval.

panels.title: Configuration reloads
panels.description: Reloads by result, in each interval.

panels.title: Configuration generation
panels.description: Generation of the configuration in use.

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Alerts delivered by channel and result, in each interval.
